cause: FQ4'24 revenue $86.6M beat consensus, subscription revenue accelerated to +41% YoY (from 23% prior quarter), FCF turned positive ($18.8M), operating loss far better than guided, and FY25 revenue guidance of $370-395M (~23% growth) issued
quality: 质量恶化: subscription acceleration and FCF turn positive are genuine, but Total RPO declined 36% YoY (worse than the -28.8% seen the prior quarter) and Current RPO fell 12% YoY - a second consecutive quarter of deteriorating forward bookings even as headline revenue beats, plus management guided gross margin degradation in FY25 from higher pilot mix
reason: This is the same company that showed a troubling RPO decline last quarter (Feb-24, -28.8% YoY), and this quarter the decline worsened to -36% YoY total RPO - a repeat, deepening pattern rather than a one-off pricing-transition noise as management claims. FY25 guidance still embeds a wide operating loss range ($95-125M) and explicit margin degradation, so the 'beat' is largely expense discipline plus favorable mix timing, not a broad-based re-rating of the business.
red_flags: 总RPO同比下滑36%(连续第二季度恶化,前季度为-28.8%);当期RPO同比下滑12%;管理层指引FY25毛利率将因试点占比上升而下降;FY25经营亏损指引区间仍宽($95-125M)
